title: Authenticated OGC Records HTTP client and Features ETS prerequisite diagnostic

source.description: Redistributable source lock and deterministic report for the real local Records/auth routes, an independent hypermedia client, and a separately obtained official Features ETS runner.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: An independent same-origin hypermedia client traverses the real authenticated Records routes, validates mandatory discovery/media/profile/filter behavior, and observes the shared bearer and organization denial controls without logging the token.

The pinned final Features ETS candidate run has zero failures only after explicit test-only auth, candidate declaration, and Records-to-Features vocabulary mapping; the production conformance declaration remains empty.
